subject: Phase 2 expansion addendum & MSA redline coordination
messages:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@terraworks.com>

Cc: procurement@terraworks.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Phase 2: capacity increase + term change (initial ask)

Hi Elliot / Marissa,

Expecting a brief heads up — leadership approved moving forward with Phase 2 (additional 200M tokens/month, new 24-mo term with an optional 12-mo renewal through Q4). We need an addendum to the existing MSA that:
- Increases committed capacity (details below)
- Adjusts termination notice window from 60 -> 90 days for the renewed term
- Adds an explicit data residency stanza for US-only processing for a subset of workloads

Can you share a proposed order form + MSA addendum we can review? Procurement would like to see pricing baked into the order form and any one-off onboarding credit reflected.

Summary ask: send redlineed MSA/OrderForm and a short summary of changes by EOD Wed PT.

Thanks,
Alex Ruiz
Director of AI Ops | TerraWorks
[Attachment: TerraWorks_Capacity_Request.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800

Thanks Alex — congrats on approval. I'm looping in Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (legal ops) to get the paperwork moving.

Plan:
1) I'll produce a draft order form reflecting the 200M token uplift + one-time onboarding credit.
2) Marissa will prepare an MSA addendum redline focusing on term length, notice window, and the data residency clause.
3) Ben will confirm pricing tiers and any pro-rated invoicing for the current billing cycle.

Marissa — can you prioritize a redline and short summary? Target: Wed 17:00 PT. If external legal needs to weigh in, please flag which clauses are likely to attract counsel comments so we can preempt them.

Elliot Price

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: elliot_price@redwood.com, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@terraworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phase 2: capacity increase + term change (initial ask)

Elliot / Alex — draft redline attached. High-level notes below.

Action items included in the redline (MSA_redline_TerraWorks_20280214.docx):
- Term: proposed 24 months starting on the Effective Date of the addendum; added auto-renew opt-in language at the end of term (customer must opt-in).
- Termination: extended notice window to 90 days; included carve-out for material breach with standard cure period.
- Data residency: added Section 7.4. Customer-specified workloads will be restricted to US regions; Redwood will provide proof of region routing in logs via Console.
- Pricing & order form mapping: see embedded Exhibit A; clarified that burst usage beyond committed tokens will be billed at on-demand rates unless a separate burst agreement is signed.

Open questions for TerraWorks / procurement:
- Do you require audit rights for host infrastructure? Our standard is SOC2 + access to logs; formal on-prem audits require enterprise package.
- Confirmation on whether onboarding credit is applied against first invoice or spread across first three months.

Next steps: please review the redline and mark up any sections you want counsel to comment on; if acceptable, we will convert to a clean order form and circulate for signature.

Marissa Cole
Senior Legal Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_redline_TerraWorks_20280214.docx (docx)]

From: Nikhil Gupta <n.gupta@lawfirmllp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, elliot_price@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@terraworks.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phase 2: capacity increase + term change (initial ask)

Marissa / Elliot — counsel here for TerraWorks. Quick review of the MSA redline attached. Key comments inline (high level):

1) Data residency language: need to add explicit assurance about subcontractors and cross-border transfers (we propose a narrow carve-in allowing transfers only to sub-processors bound by standard contractual clauses).
2) Notice period: TerraWorks can accept 90 days, but requests a 60-day remediation period for service credits eligibility (we think 90 days notice + 60-day remediation is reasonable).
3) Audit rights: TerraWorks requests limited audit rights (once annually) for encryption key handling and access logs; they propose to perform audits via a third-party vendor.

I'll add tracked changes to the doc and return by end of day tomorrow. Please let me know if Redwood has a standard approach to handling audit scope / redaction for multi-tenant logs.

Regards,
Nikhil Gupta
Partner, Compliance & Privacy | LawFirmLLP

From: elliot_price@redwood.com <elliot_price@redwood.com>

- Ben: confirm how the onboarding credit will be shown on invoice (single-line credit vs three-month amortized). Need this for TerraWorks procurement.
- Alex / Procurement: once we have the updated redline + one-pager on audit scope, I'll convert to a clean Order Form and send a DocuSign package. Can we target next Tue for signature?
